body:
Hi Sara,

Excuses that my answer took a bit longer. As you can imagine a lot of last-minute preparations going on this week.

Thank you a lot for all the changes on your side. The linebreak shouldn’t be an issue then. And the chat function will be of great help. We really appreciate that you include this without charge, so a big ‘thank you’ once more! J

Regarding the partially saved survey responses, I had mixed results as well (on iOs). I tested three more times: In test1 (save & continue later) my partial responses actually were saved. However in test2 (save & continue later) and test 3 (exit survey without saving it), actually no results were saved. So not entirely sure why I got mixed results as well. In either case, I’ve added the screenshots if they are of any help.

Also, a small update on the timeline:
If everything goes alright we will start recruiting next Monday. This would mean that on the 2/3 October we can provide you with the first CSV for the first batch of participants.

Best,
Jonas

Dear Amin Ghaffari, Could you please assign this to the appropriate person as discussed in our meeting? It appears that sometimes answers are not saved when users close the app or choose the "continue later" option. Thanks.
  • Study ID: 3843 (Prod)
  • User IDs: AID 101115 and AID 97152
Please focus solely on the "Regarding the partially saved survey responses..." paragraph as we are addressing other topics elsewhere. Thank you.

Mohammad Hashemian As OMD has a lot on his plate, and he's currently mourning the loss of his cousin, i've assigned it to ALJ for a quick initial probe. I might re-assign it to OMD later but for now I think ALJ can get the job done.
